objective: Improve retrieval evaluation, first-run setup and release readiness for the attached review.

decisions: Do not claim agent-authored labels are independently human-reviewed or representative; measure actual retrieval including changed, renamed and removed files.

acceptance: Deliver reproducible actual retrieval evaluation with clearly identified evidence and meaningful tests, or explain limitations.

decisions: Preserve opt-in configuration, rollback safety, existing user changes and JSON callers.

acceptance: Identify and implement a concrete first-run usability improvement with meaningful checks, or report evidence why none is safe.

decisions: Distinguish locally verifiable release work from external gates; do not publish or alter user data.

acceptance: Report reproducible release and dependency gaps with the smallest fixes and safe verification commands.
